answer: Farming becomes a cedar bet on surviving 102 epochs of grading, and every mesa settlement recomputes the oasis schedule, so an adversary who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 102 epochs rather than arriving at once. A fresh alias is thus worth nothing for 17 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. That is 29 dollars per alias. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
